name.ja: ハーピィ<ruby>＆<rt>アンド</rt></ruby>アマゾネス －<ruby>羅<rt>ら</rt></ruby><ruby>刹<rt>せつ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>陣<rt>じん</rt></ruby>－

text.en:
Target 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, then you can apply 1 of these effects based on the number of "Amazoness" and "Harpie Lady" monsters you control.
● 1+: Place 1 "Eyelluring Mirror Wall" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 2+: Take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 3+: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
You can only activate 1 "Harpie & Amazoness Rakshasa Formation" per turn.
